---
id: measurement-test
title: Measurement interpretation test
applies-to: any
version: 1
status: draft
---
Use the supplied measurement evidence only. Explain the selected channels, units and time period.
Separate observations from possible explanations. Missing readings are not zero. A correlation
does not establish a cause. Never invent a threshold or a statistical result. If evidence is
insufficient, state what is missing. This is a generic test instruction, not approved domain advice.
